reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI listed among revolutions Africa joins
themes.definition: AI named in a list of current technological and energy revolutions that a region aspires to join, with no further discussion.
themes.inclusion: Include single-sentence mentions listing AI alongside digitalization, renewables or other trends.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages that elaborate AI's risks, benefits or governance.
themes.boundary_cases: If the aspiration to 'join' is linked to explicit capacity or divide arguments, code AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE instead.

examples.quote: joining the revolutions currently taking place in the fields of artificial intelligence, digitalization and renewable energy

themes.label: Africa not a marginal AI consumer
themes.definition: Refusal that Africa remain marginal or a mere consumer of AI, and concern AI becomes a new North-South development gap.
themes.inclusion: Include passages warning of AI creating North-South gaps or relegating regions to consumers.
themes.exclusion: Exclude generic development statements without AI/technology.
themes.boundary_cases: Investment in scientific and digital capacities in the same passage also counts under AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING.

examples.quote: not a new label for another development gap between the North and the South
we cannot accept that Africa would remain on the margins or simply become a consumer of its outputs

themes.label: Investing in African scientific and digital capacities
themes.definition: Building human, scientific and digital capacities so AI becomes a tool for development.
themes.inclusion: Include calls to invest in people and skills/capacities for AI in developing regions.
themes.boundary_cases: Where framed as 'tool for development', also code AI_DEVELOPMENT_SDGS.

examples.quote: invest in the African person to build scientific and digital capacities so that artificial intelligence becomes a tool for development

themes.label: Balanced international AI regulation
themes.definition: Call for balanced and responsible international regulation of AI guaranteeing equitable access.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for international regulation of AI.
themes.boundary_cases: Regulation justified by preventing monopoly is also coded AI_SOVEREIGNTY_CONCENTRATION.

examples.quote: We call for a balanced and responsible international regulation of artificial intelligence

themes.label: Against AI monopoly by a few
themes.definition: Concern that AI becomes an exclusive privilege or monopoly of a few and that state sovereignty must be preserved.
themes.inclusion: Include passages opposing AI monopoly/concentration or invoking state sovereignty in AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude access-gap statements without concentration/sovereignty language.
themes.boundary_cases: 'Shared opportunity' language alone without monopoly framing belongs to AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE.

examples.quote: rather than an exclusive privilege or monopoly in the hands of a few

value.rationale: Algeria's 2024 passage is a one-line list mention of AI; the 2026 passage substantively argues against an AI North-South gap and monopoly, calling for capacity investment and balanced international regulation.
